mapper.select: -- 受控发布内需要新语句时点重验成员到期，不能冻结到事务开始时点。 SELECT p.id AS principal_id, p.version AS principal_version, m.id AS membership_id, m.generation AS membership_generation, m.version AS membership_version, m.tenant_id FROM auth_governance.login_identity li JOIN auth_governance.principal p ON p.id = li.principal_id JOIN auth_governance.membership m ON m.principal_id = p.id JOIN auth_governance.tenant t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE li.issuer = #{issuer} AND li.subject = #{subject} AND m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND p.kind = 'HUMAN' AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.valid_from <= statement_timestamp() AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to > statement_timestamp())
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.principal(id, kind, status, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{kind}, #{status}, #{version}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, kind, status, version FROM auth_governance.principal WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.login_identity(issuer, subject, principal_id) VALUES (#{issuer}, #{subject}, #{principalId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT issuer, subject, principal_id FROM auth_governance.login_identity WHERE issuer = #{issuer} AND subject = #{subject}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.tenant(id, code, status, version) VALUES (#{id}, #{code}, #{status}, #{version}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT id, code, status, version FROM auth_governance.tenant WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.membership(id, tenant_id, principal_id, member_kind, status, generation, version, valid_from, valid_to, sponsor_membership_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantId}, #{principalId}, #{memberKind}, #{status}, #{generation}, #{version}, #{validFrom}, #{validTo,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, #{sponsorMembershipId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT m.id, m.tenant_id, m.principal_id, m.member_kind, m.status, m.generation, m.version, m.valid_from, m.valid_to, m.sponsor_membership_id FROM auth_governance.membership m JOIN auth_governance.principal p ON p.id = m.principal_id JOIN auth_governance.tenant t ON t.id = m.tenant_id WHERE m.principal_id = #{principalId} AND p.kind = 'HUMAN' AND p.status = 'ACTIVE' AND t.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.status = 'ACTIVE' AND m.valid_from <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP AND (m.valid_to IS NULL OR m.valid_to > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP) ORDER BY m.tenant_id, m.id LIMIT 101
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.legacy_identity_binding(source_system, source_tenant_ref, source_subject_ref, principal_id, membership_id, tenant_id) VALUES (#{sourceSystem}, #{sourceTenantRef}, #{sourceSubjectRef}, #{principalId}, #{membershipId}, #{tenantId}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO auth_governance.command_record(operator_ref, tenant_id, operation, command_id, payload_hash) VALUES (#{operatorRef}, #{tenantId}, #{operation}, #{commandId}, #{payloadHash}) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING

INSERT INTO auth_governance.audit_event(id, operator_ref, tenant_id, operation, target_id, target_version, command_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{operatorRef}, #{tenantId}, #{operation}, #{targetId}, #{targetVersion}, #{commandId})
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_governance.membership SET status = 'SUSPENDED', version = version + 1, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE auth_governance.principal SET status = 'SUSPENDED', version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'ACTIVE'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO auth_governance.audit_event(id, operator_ref, tenant_id, operation, target_id, target_version, command_id, reason, previous_status, resulting_status, previous_version) VALUES (#{id}, #{operatorRef}, #{tenantId}, #{operation}, #{targetId}, #{targetVersion}, #{commandId}, #{reason}, #{previousStatus}, #{resultingStatus}, #{previousVersion})
mapper.update: UPDATE auth_governance.membership SET status = 'LEFT', version = version + 1, updated_at = clock_timestamp() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND version = #{expectedVersion} AND status = 'ACTIVE' AND member_kind IN ('PARTNER', 'GUEST')
